prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a serene mountain campsite scene. On the left stands a woman in a yellow raincoat holding a metal mug, her posture relaxed as she gazes toward the center. In the center sits a man with a bushy beard on a blue folding chair, leaning back comfortably while looking up at the sky. Next to him on the right is a small orange tent pitched firmly on the grass, its flap open to reveal a sleeping bag inside. A brown dog with floppy ears lies peacefully beside the tent, resting its head on its paws. Above the group, a black kite shaped like a dragon flies high against the clear blue backdrop, tethered by a thin string held by the woman. A green backpack rests on the ground near the man’s feet, slightly tilted to one side. The woman is handing the metal mug to the man, who reaches out with one hand to accept it. The brown dog is looking at the orange tent, seemingly curious about the open flap. There is no fire or smoke visible in the scene, keeping the atmosphere clean and crisp. The composition balances the figures across the horizontal plane, with the woman on the left anchoring the interaction, the man and his chair occupying the central space, and the tent and dog providing visual weight on the right. The simple shapes and bold colors define the objects clearly without shading or gradient effects, adhering strictly to the flat design aesthetic. The distant mountains form a jagged purple silhouette along the horizon, framing the campsite neatly.
